findings.title: Floated button inside the new flex container loses its right alignment
findings.body: `.small-action` is converted to `display: flex` in this PR, but the `button` rule inside it still relies on `float: right`. Floats are ignored on flex items, so if the button is a direct child of `.small-action`, it stops being pushed to the right edge and sits right after `.small-action-desc`. `.small-action-desc` has no `flex-grow`, so nothing fills the remaining space to keep the button at the end. The button needs `margin-left: auto` (or the float should be removed and the placement set through flex properties). Otherwise the action button in small-action posts visibly moves.

findings.title: `align-items` mixin emits a bogus `-ms-align-items` property
findings.body: `-ms-align-items` is not a real CSS property. The correct IE10 prefixed property is `-ms-flex-align`, which the same mixin already emits on line 120. The line is dead and misleading: it suggests IE support is covered by a property name that browsers never recognise. It should be removed.

findings.title: `order(2)` on `.extra-info-wrapper` has no effect unless its parent is a flex container
findings.body: `order` only applies to flex or box items. This PR does not make the parent of `.extra-info-wrapper` (`#topic-title`) a flex container, and no changed file does. Unless another stylesheet establishes flex layout there, the `@include order(2)` is a no-op. The same change also adds `line-height: 1.5`, which is unrelated to ordering. The author should confirm the flex parent exists or drop the ordering.

findings.title: Bullet badge top margin inside `.extra-info-wrapper` removed without replacement
findings.body: The `&.bullet { margin-top: 5px; }` rule under `.extra-info-wrapper .badge-wrapper` is deleted, and nothing replaces it. Bullet badges in the topic title lose their 5px top offset, which changes their vertical alignment. The PR does not mention this and the title only refers to performance, so it looks like an unintended visual regression.

findings.title: PR description is a placeholder and does not explain the many visual changes
findings.body: The description reads only "Test 5", and the title claims a performance optimization. The diff is a layout refactor from floats to flexbox across header, topic title, post, small-action and badge styles. It also changes spacing: `.small-action-desc` loses its vertical padding and 4em left padding, `margin-top` is removed, and `.title` and `.panel` float rules are replaced. None of this is justified, and no performance measurement is offered. Reviewers cannot tell which changes are intentional or how they were verified, so the description should explain the intent and the visual impact.
